column1: # STATUS: LIVE, 2026-11-17. How the host/guest diff treats each NVML field, query and nvidia-smi value (scripts/apps/open_rows/nvml_lib.py).
# glob over `kind:key`, first match wins; class: static (host and guest must be equal), live (equal within param: abs:N or rel:F),
# numeric (only that the guest answers a NUMBER is asserted: the default), ignore (never compared). These tolerances are INFERRED and
# will move with the first guest run; a loosened line needs its reason on the line above it. Lines with a reason were set from native logs.
# identity and per-process data differ by construction
# utilisation, clocks, power, temperature are live counters of the same physical die read at different instants
# clocks follow the P-state: 210 MHz idle and 1777 MHz boosted were both logged on one die class (traces/open_rows_ffdcgm_20261117), so only the number is owed
# memory: the guest sees kayfabe's frame-buffer size policy (fb-mb), not the die's total (docs/design/V3_GFX_TESTSET.md); only the number is asserted
# identity-like statics: the same die must report the same values in the guest
# persistence and virtualization modes are configuration of the machine, not of the die
